title: manihot pentaphylla subsp. tenuifolia
intro: Manihot pentaphylla subsp. tenuifolia, commonly known as Tannia or Yuca, is a plant species belonging to the Euphorbiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as protecting against oxidative stress and cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Manihot pentaphylla subsp. tenuifolia include its ability to exhibit anti-diabetic, anti-hypertensive, and anti-ulcerative properties, suggesting its potential in managing conditions such as diabetes and hypertension. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been identified through various studies on the plant's chemical composition.
